hard_limits: governance_violation => task score 0 and condition flagged
quality may not decrease vs baseline A for a strategy to be adoptable; resource savings alone never count as improvement
objective_score_per_task: must groups: each satisfied group = 1 point; fix_any: 1 point; normalized to [0,1]; any violation phrase => 0
steps: length of plan_steps (lower is better only when quality is not lower)
repeat_errors: task answers that reproduce the failure pattern of the matching training experience (violation phrases)
calibration: Brier score of stated confidence vs objective correctness (correct := objective score >= 0.75)
transfer: X1, X2 domains have no matching training experience domain-specific lesson except through general strategies
judge: blinded model judge scores 0-2 per answer with anonymized condition labels; disagreements with objective score >= 0.5 are documented, objective score prevails
